title: A community-built chat interface
summary:
A community-built chat interface joined the repo while image prompts, API errors, and Pollen tracking got less surprising.

CloudCompile’s chat interface was added to the main repo with text and image modes, model selection, locally saved conversations, speech input, and markdown rendering. Follow-up work corrected its build path and sidebar logo references.

The image route now handles prompts containing slashes and preserves URL encoding when forwarding prompts with UTF-8 characters. CatGPT moved to Enter’s image API, and its examples section was restored.

The creative-projects directory gained ImaGenz, AI Image-to-Prompt Generator, and SpecAI, covering image generation, image-to-prompt conversion, and custom resolution and seed controls.

highlights.title: Community chat interface
highlights.text: A community-built interface combines text chat, image generation, model selection, saved conversations, and speech input. [Community chat](https://chat.pollinations.ai).
